RED if the rider is keyed to every shot/charge with no swap gate (hundreds of procs fight-wide), and RED if the rider is missing entirely.

RED if the 'stage target' conditional is dropped (sum 150) or the base line dropped (sum 380.46). The scope-lock boss IS the stage target, so the line is unconditionally live here.

RED under a pre-summed 42% single apply, under an uncapped pool, and under a t=0 first fire. The hitRatePct→core-rate conversion itself is the engine's ⚑ HRCORE path and is deliberately not re-asserted here.

Ordinal + temporal: ≥1 Memory Absorption apply precedes the first atkPct=15.2 apply and its frame ≥ 300 (t≈6s); target is self only. RED if the stage buff is authored as a passive live from frame 0 (0 preceding stacks, frame 0).
≥9 stack applies precede the first attackDamagePct=20.27 and frame ≥ 1740 (t≈30s), self-only. RED under passive-from-0 and under a gate set at the wrong threshold (e.g. 2 stacks ⇒ t≈6s).

≥29 stack applies precede the first coreDamagePct=21.05 and frame ≥ 5100 (t≈90s — half the fight), self-only; plus a non-vacuity check that nayuta deals damage both before and after that frame so both regimes are exercised. RED under passive-from-0, which would over-credit ~90s of core damage.
The union of targetSlugs across all three stage magnitudes is exactly {nayuta}. RED if any stage buff leaks to allies (a plausible mis-read given skill1's sibling block is ally-scoped).
